_about: Credential registry for tokencheck.py (weekly token check). Copy to credentials.json and edit; keep credentials.json out of version control. NEVER put a secret value in this file — only the path to where the secret lives and the name of the key inside it. Paths: `~` = home. Check kinds: google_refresh (OAuth refresh-token grant against Google, nothing written back; format flat|gdrive3|drivemcp), cmd (CLI exit code; optional jwt_exp reads a stored JWT's expiry), http_bearer (read-only HTTP GET with the stored token, status code only; `{token}` in the URL puts it in the path instead of an Authorization header), claude_mcp (status line from one `claude mcp list` run from the workspace), manual (no automated check). `scope` = the run-record folder the result lands in (default `general`). `relogin` = the exact command printed when the credential is dead or expiring. Set `enabled: false` to skip an entry.

credentials.name: Google account used by a mail MCP server
credentials.relogin: Re-run the mail server's auth command (see its README)

credentials.name: Example REST API token
credentials.relogin: Create a new token in the example.com settings and paste it into ~/.config/example-api/.env
